dataset: CERTH agricultural material handling, author-released original recordings

orientation.gyro_units: rad/s per dataset README; CSV headers say deg/s
orientation.initialization: first accelerometer sample; reset for each recording

readout_optimizer: sample-wise SGD without momentum or weight decay

time_control.features: elapsed seconds only; no total-duration normalization

selection_metric: validation macro-F1 over all six classes; never test scores
module_ablations: No Spatial Pooler (same TM dimensions, encoder bits directly)
No Temporal Memory (same fitted SP and a current-label readout)
No auxiliary loss (weight zero; same fitted backbone)
metric_aggregation: pooled held-out frames; macro precision/recall/F1; zero_division=0; sample-class probability MAE/MSE/RMSE
reporting: mean and sample standard deviation over three model seeds; a single pre-specified participant split
claims_scope: new public-data evaluation; no newly collected cohort; no target-workstation latency benchmark
